title: phaseolus vulgaris var. abbreviatus
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. abbreviatus, commonly known as the dwarf kidney bean or short bush bean, is a variant of the common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris) characterized by its compact growth habit. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including lowering cholesterol levels, managing blood sugar levels, and providing antioxidant properties that can help protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Phaseolus vulgaris var. abbreviatus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant also include isoflavones, anthocyanins, and other phytochemicals that contribute to its medicinal properties.
